target_customer: College students and local communities who want real-time alerts about nearby events
problem: Official campus alerts arrive late or not at all, so students wanted fast crowd-sourced warnings about safety incidents and local news.
business_model: Free consumer app, no revenue model found
product_category: hyperlocal social news and safety alert app

founders.name: Vinay A. Ramesh
founders.background_notes: The company's closing message is signed by Hriday, Jay and Vinay.

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile app with geo-targeted push alerts and moderation; standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Campus-by-campus user density gave some network effect, but alert apps were easy to copy and depended on moderation to stay credible.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Citizen and Nextdoor grew in the same space later; the Wildfire team joined Opendoor in 2021.

market_need_then: Student coverage in 2017 described Wildfire as faster than official police alerts during a 2016 shooting near campus, indicating demand for faster alerts.

branding.community_and_virality: Covered by many college newspapers in 2017 and 2018 as it spread campus to campus.

brand_strength.rationale: Campus press coverage shows local awareness, but the name is shared with many unrelated wildfire products and no brand assets are documented.

pivots.to: Social news app for local events
pivots.why: Company says it quickly grew beyond a campus safety tool

outcome_analysis: Wildfire grew from a Berkeley senior-year safety alert app into a social news app that sent 65 million alerts to nearly 1 million users over six years, but no monetization or large funding is documented. The team announced it was joining Opendoor, which reads as a soft landing for a small team with a consumer product that had reach but no clear business model. Deal date and terms are not public.
notes: Opendoor acquisition year 2021 comes from profile sites and the company's own closing page without a date; treat date as approximate. Funding of about $3.17M (Wellfound) versus $250K (Simplify) conflict and no press or filing confirmed any round, so no round is recorded and coverage is partial. Competitor sources found were dated 2019 or later, so the list is empty. failure_factors weak_willingness_to_pay is an inference from the absence of any monetization in sources.
